name: copywriting-specialists
description: Layer 2/2 — the specialists: a copywriter who writes any text from the material it is given, in the register the caller names or the material implies, a reviewer who checks facts, runs the AI-text detectors and says how the text lands, and a layouter who builds the Word document and proves every page renders. The three are peers and call each other. /article-init stands up an article's repository.
